actionableRisks.summary: PathIsRelativeW is not a fully-qualified path test: Windows drive-relative C:child and root-relative backslash-child need explicit rejection or canonicalization. Current smoke uses strict absolute mkdtemp paths and does not validate those edge forms. PathIsRootW also must be applied to the canonical path before claiming all root aliases rejected.
actionableRisks.recommendation: Accept explicitly fully-qualified drive-letter colon backslash or UNC server/share/subdirectory forms, canonicalize before root and ancestor checks, and add disposable fixture negative cases for drive-relative/root-relative/dot-root aliases. This source-only reviewer did not launch installers to prove a destructive bypass.

actionableRisks.summary: Compile and source review do not prove final NSIS FindFirst/GetLastError/Section behavior. The prior actual first-install failure demonstrates that runtime evidence is required.
actionableRisks.recommendation: Root must run the complete rebuilt isolated smoke, retaining exact candidate SHA, phase exit codes and sentinel/registration outcome before marking installer PASS.

actionableRisks.summary: Existing safe uninstall deletes its marker before replacement extraction/customInstall rewrites it. Interruption may leave a partial nonempty unmarked directory needing reviewed manual recovery; this empty-directory repair does not add transactional upgrade rollback.
